pages.title: Bring discoveries home
pages.text: Blueprints unlock patterns without being consumed. Store them beside a Constructor to make equipment back at base.$(br2)Some upgrades are found directly as loot. Check Storage Cubes and keep room for unfamiliar modules.$(br2)Build a fuel supply and improve your gear before tackling the largest complexes.

pages.title: Sort your key cards
pages.text: Soldiers can drop city cards, but permissions vary. Keep door access, storage access and forcefield immunity cards until you have checked them.$(br2)A city name identifies the destination, not every permission.$(br2)The card from the final AI Core is your storage-access reward. Use the Ariente chapter’s Key Cards entry if a lock rejects you.
